en: A hand-colored vintage street-view postcard showing a cobblestone street lined with multi-story buildings and shops. The perspective looks down a long, gently curving street with pedestrians in the distance. Storefront signs in German advertise various products and businesses. The sky is tinted pastel blue and pink. At the top in red text it reads 'Pirna a. Elbe. Lange Strasse.' indicating the location. The bottom margin contains the publisher information and number.
